design.quote: Anxiety disorders are often associated with impairments in memory, attention, decision‑making, and psychomotor function, leading to a reduced quality of life (QoL). Alprazolam, commonly prescribed for acute anxiety disorders, has generated interest regarding its potential impact on anxiety‑associated cognitive and psychomotor impairment, especially since effects of short‑term use have not been well studied.
